payload.body: Verified actual Fly billing in dashboard. July 1-Aug 1 invoice YBA8PNEE-0007 was paid at .84. Main charges: gitruntime-db MPG .26 + .89 storage; chill-db MPG .37 + .27 storage; ordinary Machine CPU .42; additional RAM .45; app-scoped egress IP .72; volumes .93; Tigris /bin/zsh.46; bandwidth /bin/zsh.02. Current Jul 27-Aug 2 Cost Explorer total is .01 (.57/day, ~ /month). Both MPG clusters currently contribute .04/week each. Managed clusters: gitruntime-db (sjc, Shared x2, 1GB RAM, 10GB storage) and chill-db (lax, Shared x2, 1GB RAM, 10GB storage).
